change.label: Open 30 minutes earlier at 6:30 instead of 7:00

summary: Opening 30 minutes earlier generated 16.5 in additional revenue while reducing walkouts by 3, though wait times increased by 0.6 minutes. The largest metric shifts were the revenue gain of 16.5 and the walkout reduction, likely driven by the earlier availability capturing demand that would otherwise go unserved. Product mix shifted notably toward lattes (up 6 orders) and tea (up 4 orders) while bagels fell by 6 orders, suggesting the earlier timing attracted different customer preferences. At the segment level, students gained significantly with revenue up 33.0, but office workers declined by 12.5 and locals dropped 7.25, indicating the earlier slot better serves student schedules than traditional commuters.
